cards.example_en: My cousin chose a vocational course in plumbing.
cards.example_zh: 我表亲选了一门管道安装维修职业课程。
cards.explain_zh: 常修饰education、training，强调具体职业技能。

cards.example_en: Expanding vocational education can help young people develop practical skills that match the needs of local employers.
cards.example_zh: 扩大职业教育能帮助年轻人掌握符合当地雇主需求的实用技能。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The council provides bins for the disposal of batteries.
cards.example_zh: 市政部门提供专门的回收箱，用于处理废旧电池。
cards.explain_zh: at someone's disposal 表示供某人使用或支配。

cards.example_en: Safe waste disposal is essential for protecting groundwater and reducing health risks in densely populated areas.
cards.example_zh: 安全处置废弃物对于保护地下水和降低人口密集地区的健康风险至关重要。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Weekly visits from neighbours helped reduce her sense of isolation.
cards.example_zh: 邻居每周的探望帮助减轻了她的孤独感。
cards.explain_zh: in isolation可指独自，也可指脱离背景单独考虑。

cards.example_en: Investment in community centres may reduce social isolation among older residents who live alone.
cards.example_zh: 投资建设社区中心可能减少独居老年居民的社会孤立感。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.meaning_zh: 放肆却讨喜的；厚脸皮的
cards.example_en: The child gave a cheeky grin and took another biscuit.
cards.example_zh: 那孩子调皮地咧嘴一笑，又拿了一块饼干。
cards.explain_zh: 指调皮放肆，不是胖乎乎；胖乎乎用chubby。

cards.example_en: The child gave a cheeky grin and took another biscuit.
cards.example_zh: 那孩子调皮地咧嘴一笑，又拿了一块饼干。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The clinic offers supportive care for people with obesity.
cards.example_zh: 这家诊所为肥胖症患者提供支持性照护。
cards.explain_zh: 不可数名词；可用people with obesity称患者。

cards.example_en: The farmer carefully removed the sheep's thick fleece.
cards.example_zh: 农场主小心地剪下了绵羊厚厚的毛。
cards.explain_zh: 面料义通常不可数；a fleece 可指一件抓绒衣。

cards.example_en: Although synthetic fleece provides affordable warmth, washing it can release tiny plastic fibres into waterways.
cards.example_zh: 虽然合成抓绒面料保暖又实惠，但清洗时可能将微小塑料纤维释放到水道中。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: My fingers went numb while I waited in the snow.
cards.example_zh: 我在雪中等候时，手指冻麻了。
cards.explain_zh: 词尾b不发音；既可指身体麻木，也可指情感麻木。

cards.example_en: This small camera accessory keeps my photos steady.
cards.example_zh: 这个小巧的相机配件能让我拍照时保持稳定。
cards.explain_zh: 配件常用复数accessories；从犯后常接to。

cards.example_en: The new bakery received plenty of publicity after opening.
cards.example_zh: 那家新面包店开业后获得了大量媒体关注。
cards.explain_zh: 不可数；不同于advertising，不一定是付费广告。

cards.example_en: Positive publicity can attract visitors to lesser-known destinations, creating employment opportunities for local residents.
cards.example_zh: 正面宣传可以吸引游客前往鲜为人知的目的地，为当地居民创造就业机会。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Modern ventilation systems suck polluted air out of buildings, helping to maintain a healthier indoor environment.
cards.example_zh: 现代通风系统将污浊空气从建筑内抽出，有助于维持更健康的室内环境。
cards.explain_zh: 表示“很糟糕”时属非正式用语，不宜用于学术写作。

cards.example_en: The rooster woke us just before sunrise this morning.
cards.example_zh: 今天早上，天快亮时公鸡就把我们叫醒了。
cards.explain_zh: rooster常用于美式英语；cockerel尤指年轻公鸡。

cards.example_en: The coldness of the water made me gasp.
cards.example_zh: 冰冷的水让我倒吸了一口气。
cards.explain_zh: 可指温度低，也可指态度不友好，通常不可数。

cards.example_en: The coldness of the water made me gasp.
cards.example_zh: 冰冷的水让我倒吸了一口气。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We climbed the hill to explore the old fortress.
cards.example_zh: 我们爬上山丘，探访那座古老的要塞。
cards.explain_zh: 指防御坚固的要塞；castle更强调城堡建筑。

cards.example_en: This tiny heater is inadequate for such a large room.
cards.example_zh: 这么大的房间用这个小暖气，供暖远远不够。
cards.explain_zh: 常用inadequate for；指数量不足或质量不达标。

cards.example_en: The filter removes a common pollutant from industrial wastewater.
cards.example_zh: 这个过滤器可去除工业废水中的一种常见污染物。
cards.explain_zh: pollutant指具体污染物，可数；pollution指污染。

cards.example_en: This filter removes harmful pollutants from our drinking water.
cards.example_zh: 这个过滤器能去除我们饮用水中的有害污染物。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We enjoy an occasional picnic beside the river.
cards.example_zh: 我们喜欢偶尔到河边野餐。
cards.explain_zh: occasional修饰名词；occasionally修饰动词。

cards.example_en: He complained bitterly when his bicycle was stolen again.
cards.example_zh: 自行车再次被偷后，他愤愤不平地抱怨。
cards.explain_zh: 常修饰负面情绪或cold，不宜泛用于积极形容词。

cards.example_en: During bitterly cold winters, poorly insulated homes increase energy costs and put vulnerable residents' health at risk.
cards.example_zh: 在严寒的冬季，保温不良的住宅会增加能源开支，并危及弱势居民的健康。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Some economists argue that governments should abolish subsidies that encourage excessive consumption of fossil fuels.
cards.example_zh: 一些经济学家主张，政府应废除鼓励过度消耗化石燃料的补贴。
cards.explain_zh: 常接法律、制度或惯例，不用于取消普通预约。

cards.example_en: She planted bamboo along the fence for extra privacy.
cards.example_zh: 她沿着围栏种了竹子，让院子更私密。
cards.explain_zh: 泛指竹子或竹材时通常不可数。

cards.example_en: My brother listens to rap while he cooks dinner.
cards.example_zh: 我哥哥做晚饭时会听说唱音乐。
cards.explain_zh: rap重读闭音节结尾：rapped、rapping双写p。

cards.example_en: The shepherd led the sheep home before sunset.
cards.example_zh: 牧羊人在日落前把羊群领回了家。
cards.explain_zh: 作动词通常及物：shepherd sb into/through某处。

cards.example_en: Museum staff shepherd visitors through crowded galleries to ensure that everyone can move safely between exhibits.
cards.example_zh: 博物馆工作人员引导游客穿过拥挤的展厅，确保所有人都能在展品之间安全通行。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Her bright scarf makes a striking contrast with her coat.
cards.example_zh: 她鲜艳的围巾与外套形成了鲜明对比。
cards.explain_zh: 表示醒目或显著，不一定表示令人震惊。

cards.example_en: Her bright scarf makes a striking contrast with her coat.
cards.example_zh: 她鲜艳的围巾与外套形成了鲜明对比。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Check the copyright before using that photo on your website.
cards.example_zh: 在网站上使用那张照片前，先查清它的版权情况。
cards.explain_zh: 版权是copyright；专利权是patent，勿混用。

cards.example_en: She wrinkled her nose in disgust at the rotten fruit.
cards.example_zh: 看到腐烂的水果，她厌恶地皱起鼻子。
cards.explain_zh: disgusted形容人的感受；disgusting形容令人厌恶的事物。

cards.example_en: She wrinkled her nose in disgust at the rotten fruit.
cards.example_zh: 看到腐烂的水果，她厌恶地皱起鼻子。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: His hostile reply made everyone at the table uncomfortable.
cards.example_zh: 他充满敌意的回答让桌边的每个人都感到不自在。
cards.explain_zh: hostile to后接名词或动名词，表示敌视或反对。

cards.example_en: We stayed indoors as the typhoon shook the windows.
cards.example_zh: 台风把窗户震得直响，我们一直待在室内。
cards.explain_zh: 与hurricane均指热带气旋，名称因发生海域而异。

cards.example_en: The dry leaves curl at the edges in autumn.
cards.example_zh: 秋天，干枯的叶子边缘会卷起来。
cards.explain_zh: curl up指蜷缩身体，常用于人或动物。

cards.example_en: Our cats and dogs live together in perfect harmony.
cards.example_zh: 我们家的猫和狗相处得十分融洽。
cards.explain_zh: 常用in harmony with表示与……和谐或一致。

cards.example_en: Community projects can promote social harmony by bringing residents from different backgrounds together to achieve shared goals.
cards.example_zh: 社区项目让不同背景的居民携手实现共同目标，从而促进社会和谐。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: She hummed a gentle melody while watering the plants.
cards.example_zh: 她一边给植物浇水，一边轻声哼着曲子。
cards.explain_zh: melody指可哼唱的旋律；rhythm指节奏。

cards.example_en: She hummed a gentle melody while watering the plants.
cards.example_zh: 她一边给植物浇水，一边轻声哼着曲子。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Your first attempt looks promising; keep practising every day.
cards.example_zh: 你的初次尝试看起来很有希望；坚持每天练习吧。
cards.explain_zh: 表示有成功的潜力，不等于已经成功。

cards.example_en: My bike has a dent in its metal basket.
cards.example_zh: 我的自行车金属车篮上有一处凹痕。
cards.explain_zh: dent不是“牙齿”；make a dent in可指削减或取得进展。

cards.example_en: My bike has a dent in its metal basket.
cards.example_zh: 我的自行车金属车篮上有一处凹痕。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The clinic arranged a follow-up to check my recovery.
cards.example_zh: 诊所安排了一次复诊，以检查我的恢复情况。
cards.explain_zh: 名词、形容词带连字符；动词短语follow up不带。

cards.example_en: A follow-up study is needed to determine whether the training programme produces lasting improvements in employment outcomes.
cards.example_zh: 需要开展后续研究，以确定该培训项目是否能持续改善就业结果。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Self-employment lets me choose when I take holidays.
cards.example_zh: 自雇让我可以自己决定什么时候休假。
cards.explain_zh: 不可数；指为自己工作，不一定是创办公司。

word.example_en: My cousin chose a vocational course in plumbing.
word.example_zh: 我表亲选了一门管道安装维修职业课程。

word.example_en: Stricter controls on industrial pollutants could improve air quality and reduce respiratory illness in urban areas.
word.example_zh: 更严格地管控工业污染物可以改善空气质量，减少城市地区的呼吸道疾病。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0
